description: This file defines a dispatcher class for handling CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) sessions within the Playwright Core framework. It manages communication with a CDP session, including sending commands and handling events like session closure.

classes.name: CDPSessionDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher that manages a Chrome DevTools Protocol session, facilitating communication and event handling between the Playwright framework and the underlying browser session.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command via the CDP session and returns the result, handling progress updates.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the CDP session, with progress tracking, and marks scope as potentially closing.

ctags.name: CDPSessionDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class CDPSessionDispatcher extends Dispatcher<CDPSession, channels.CDPSessionChannel, Bro/
